Name: Beach Sounds
Author: Auriala
Description:
I tried looking for something to make the beach sound more realistic and couldn't find anything so I created this and figured that others might be interested in using it if they are unhappy with the current beach wave sounds.
[b]
**Please do not re-upload this mod as your own or upload it to any other site! Thank you!**[/b]

This mod uses Custom Music by ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/42440425]Platonymous[/url] to replace the original beach sounds with custom wave sounds to make the beach sound more realistic.


Mod Requirements -
Custom Music: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043
SMAPI: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400

Downloads.Description: This replaces the original beach sounds with a more realistic sounds.
